title: Trishanku ascends
introduction: Vishvamitra effectuates Trishanku's travel to heaven, but Indra throws him down as Trishanku has not acquired any merit to reach heaven. Vishvamitra enraged at this starts to replicate universe with constellation of stars and galaxies, and he proceeds to clone even gods. On seeing this chaotic situation, Indra with gods yield to the pertinence of Vishvamitra and allow that which Vishvamitra replicated to survive and also allow Trishanku to inhibit that pseudo Creation, but with an upside down posture.
closing: Trishanku is the son of one Suuryaaruna and his original name is Satyavrat and this name Trishanku is his pseudonym. He got this because three sins are attached to him tri-shanka-s as said in another work Harivamsha. There it is said: pituḥ śāpādi doṣeṇa | gurudogdhre vadhena ca | aprokṣito prayogāt ca | trividhā tat vyatikramaḥ | evam trīṇi asya śankūni | One by his father's damnation - when he misbehaved in his kingdom, his father being a righteous king exiles him to a wretched place. When his father was exiling him, Trishanku took umbrage at Vashishta, because Vashishta did not come to his rescue. The second blemish is due to the killing Vashishta's milch cow, knowingly. Trishanku kills that cow, when he did not get any food for the day to feed the son of Vishvamitra. At that time, he had to protect the wife and three sons of Vishvamitra, as Vishvamitra has gone away to a distant place for his ascesis, leaving his kingdom and family. Then Trishanku comes to the rescue of his family. With that gratitude, now Vishvamitra tries to requite this king in sending him to heaven. The third damnation is for his usage of unsanctified meat of his kill. Thus, Trishanku is the one who carries 'three social blemishes' on his head, and added to these is the curse of Vashishta, in making him as a profaner.

Further, a god or teacher cannot be dragged to one's side or his wishful thinking, but they are to be attained or appeased with constant faith and servitude. guroḥ alīkanirbandho na kartavyaḥ kadācana | anumānya prasāḥ ca gurukruddho yudhiṣṭara | śiṣyo gurau naraśreṣṭa pratikūlam na sañcaret | viṣṇu purāṇa And if god created the cosmos, a man trying to duplicating it, is as good as going against that writ of that god. Vishvamitra no doubt built many space stations and started cloning gods, leave alone earthly species, but he is forestalled, because he wanted to break the system from within, in which he is and by which he mastered all this expertise. It is as good as cutting the branch of a tree on which he is sitting. Absolute insolence is absolutely condemnable. Hence, Trishanku is still dangling upside down in his so-called heaven.
इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे षष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 60th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तपोबलहतान् ज्ञात्वा वासिष्ठान् समहोदयान् |
ऋषिमध्ये महातेजा विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत
verses.iast:
tapo bala hatān jñātvā vāsiṣṭhān sa mahodayān |
ṛṣi madhye mahātejā vihvāmitro abhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: "The great-resplendent Vishvamitra on knowing through his ascetic power about the ruination of the sons of Vashishta, along with Mahodaya, proclaimed this amidst the observance of sages." Sage Shataananda continued his narration of Trishanku's legend.

glosses.meaning: by ascesis, power, as ruined, on knowing

verses.devanagari:
अयमिक्ष्वाकुदायादस्त्रिशंकुरिति विश्रुतः |
धर्मिष्ठश्च वदान्यश्च मां चैव शरणं गतः
स्वेनानेन शरीरेण देवलोकजिगीषया |
verses.iast:
ayam ikṣvāku dāyādaḥ triśaṅkuḥ iti viśrutaḥ |
dharmiṣṭhaḥ ca vadānyaḥ ca mām caiva śaraṇam gataḥ
svena anena śarīreṇa deva loka jigīṣayā |
verses.translation: " 'This legatee of Ikshvaku dynasty is well-know as Trishanku, a righteous and benevolent one. He came under my shelter as he wishes to win over the heaven of gods with his own mortal body.' So Vishvamitra started to speak to sages.

glosses.meaning: righteous one, also, benevolent one, also
god's, world [heavens,] wishing to win over

verses.devanagari:
यथायं स्वशरीरेण देवलोकं गमिष्यति
तथा प्रवर्त्यतां यज्ञो भवद्भिश्च मया सह |
verses.iast:
yathā ayam sva śarīreṇa deva lokam gamiṣyati
tathā pravar.htyatām yajño bhavadbhiḥ ca mayā saha |
verses.translation: " 'You all scholars have to conduct Vedic-ritual along with in such a way as to how Trishnaku reaches the heaven of gods.' Thus Vishvamitra advised the conductors of the ritual.

verses.devanagari:
विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा सर्व एव महर्षयः
ऊचुः समेताः सहसा धर्मज्ञा धर्मसंहितम् |
verses.iast:
viśvāmitra vacaḥ śrutvā sarva eva maharṣayaḥ
ūcuḥ sametāḥ sahasā dharmajñā dharma saṃhitam |
verses.translation: "On listening the words of Vishvamitra all those great-sages have come together and quickly discussed among themselves about what is agreeable to righteousness, as they are the knowers of scruples of conducting Vedic-rituals, but such a ritual is desultory.

verses.devanagari:
अयं कुशिकदायादो मुनिः परमकोपनः
यदाह वचनं सम्यगेतत् कार्यं न संशयः |
अग्निकल्पो हि भगवान् शापं दास्यति रोषितः
verses.iast:
ayam kuśika dāyādo muniḥ parama kopanaḥ
yat āha vacanam saṃyak etat kāryam na saṃśayaḥ |
agni kalpo hi bhagavān śāpam dāsyati roṣitaḥ
verses.translation: " 'Whatever Vishvamitra says let it be translated entirely and exhaustively into deeds called ritual. This Vishvamitra is the legatee of Sage Kushi, and indeed he is a saint similar to Ritual-fire besides being an extremely furious person. Otherwise this awesome sage gives curse, rancorously.

glosses.meaning: which, sentence, he said - whatever is said by him
all this [entirely,] exhaustively, performable [translatable into deeds of ritual]

verses.devanagari:
तस्मात् प्रवर्त्यतां यज्ञः सशरीरो यथा दिवम् |
गच्छेदिक्ष्वाकुदायादो विश्वामित्रस्य तेजसा
ततः प्रवर्त्यतां यज्ञः सर्वे समधितिष्ठत |
verses.iast:
tasmāt pravartyatām yajñaḥ sa śarīro yathā divam |
gacchet ikṣvāku dāyādo viśvāmitrasya tejasā
tataḥ pravartyatām yajñaḥ sarve samadhitiṣṭhata |
verses.translation: " 'As such, let the Vedic-ritual be conducted intending and enabling Trishanku, the legatee of Ikshvaku, to go to heaven by the ritualist prowess of Vishvamitra, therefor you conduct yourselves and you all preside over it.' Thus, the officiators conceded among themselves.

glosses.meaning: as to how [intending to,] to heavens, goes [enabling to go]

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा महर्षयः संजह्रुस्ताः क्रियास्तदा
याजकश्च महातेजा विश्वामित्रोऽभवत् क्रतौ |
verses.iast:
evam uktvā maharṣayaḥ sañjahruḥ tāḥ kriyāḥ tadā
yājakaḥ ca mahātejā viśvāmitro abhavat kratau |
verses.translation: "Concluding thus those great-sages undertook concerned works of that Vedic-ritual and the great-resplendent Vishvamitra himself became its principal officiator.

verses.devanagari:
ऋत्विजश्चानुपूर्व्येण मंत्रवन्मंत्रकोविदाः
चक्रुः सर्वाणि कर्माणि यथाकल्पं यथाविधि |
verses.iast:
ṛtvijaḥ ca ānupūrvyeṇa mantravat mantra kovidāḥ
cakruḥ sa.rvāṇi ka.rmāṇi yathā kalpam yathā vidhi |
verses.translation: "Those hymnodists who are the experts in hymnodies have scripturally carried out all ceremonies in a methodical way with inviolable hymnal methods, and as per Kalpa treatise, that lays down the rules for conducting such rituals.

verses.devanagari:
ततः कालेन महता विश्वामित्रो महातपाः
चकारावाहनं तत्र भागार्थं सर्वदेवताः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ kālena mahatā viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ
cakāra āvāhanam tatra bhāga artham sarva devatāḥ |
verses.translation: "After a long time that highly ascetical Vishvamitra welcomed all the gods to receive their allotted oblations in that ritual.

verses.devanagari:
नाभ्यागमंस्तदा भागार्थं सर्वदेवताः
ततः कोपसमाविष्टो विश्वमित्रो महामुनिः |
स्रुवमुद्यम्य सक्रोधस्त्रिशंकुमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
na abhyāgaman tadā bhāga artham sarva devatāḥ
tataḥ kopa samāviṣṭo viśvamitro mahāmuniḥ |
sruvam udyaṃya sa krodhaḥ triśaṅkum idam abravīt
verses.translation: "Then all of the gods who are invited to partake of the oblation have not come forward to receive their allotments, and then the great-saint Vishvamitra, obsessive with fury, furiously lifted up a wooden-oblational-scoop, and said this to Trishanku.

glosses.meaning: , on lifting up - brandishing as if it is a magic wand

verses.devanagari:
पश्य मे तपसो वीर्यं स्वार्जितस्य नरेश्वर |
एष त्वां स्वशरीरेण नयामि स्वर्गमोजसा
दुष्प्रापं स्वशरीरेण दिवं गच्छ नराधिप |
verses.iast:
paśya me tapaso vīryam sva ārjitasya nara īśvara |
eṣa tvām sva śarīreṇa nayāmi svargam ojasā
duṣ.hprāpam sva śarīreṇa divam gaccha nara adhipa |
verses.translation: " 'Oh, ruler of people, now you shall see the potency of my ascesis which I personally achieved. Such as I am I shall lead you forth to haven with your own body just by my personal capability. Oh, king of people, now you will go to heaven with your own mortal body, which is otherwise unattainable.

glosses.meaning: to heaven, I will lead forth
with own, mortal body, you go.

verses.devanagari:
स्वार्जितं किंचिदप्यस्ति मया हि तपसः फलम्
राजन् त्वं तेजसा तस्य सशरीरो दिवं व्रज |
verses.iast:
svārjitam kiñcit api asti mayā hi tapasaḥ phalam
rājan tvam tejasā tasya sa śarīro divam vraja |
verses.translation: " 'May it be a little, but there is some fruit of my ascesis, isn't it! Oh, king, you will journey to heaven with your own body owing to that prowess of my ascesis.' Vishvamitra said so to Trishanku.

glosses.meaning: with own, body, to heaven, you journey.

verses.devanagari:
उक्तवाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन् सशरीरो नरेश्वरः
दिवं जगाम काकुत्स्थ मुनीनां पश्यतां तदा |
verses.iast:
ukta vākye munau tasmin sa śarīro nara īśvaraḥ
divam jagāma kākutstha munīnām paśyatām tadā |
verses.translation: "Once the sage Vishvamitra said those words, oh, Rama of Kakutstha, that king Trishanku soared to heaven with his mortal body, before the very eyes of other sages." Sage Shataananda continued.

verses.devanagari:
स्वर्गलोकं गतं दृष्ट्वा त्रिशंकुं पाकशासनः
सह सर्वैः सुरगणैरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
svarga lokam gatam dṛṣṭvā triśaṅkum pāka śāsanaḥ
saha sarvaiḥ sura gaṇaiḥ idam vacanam abravīt |
verses.translation: "On seeing Trishanku's entry into the realm of heaven, Indra, the subjugator of demon Paaka, spoke this sentence together with all the multitudes of gods.

glosses.meaning: heaven, realm of, he who has entered

verses.devanagari:
त्रिशंको गच्छ भूयस्त्वं नासि स्वर्गकृतालयः
गुरुशापहतो मूढ पतभूमिमवाग् शिराः |
verses.iast:
triśaṅko gaccha bhūyaḥ tvam na asi svarga kṛta ālayaḥ
guru śāpa hato mūḍha pata bhūmim avāg śirāḥ |
verses.translation: " 'Oh, Trishanku, you have not yet made heaven as your haunt, hence retrace your steps. As you are thrashed by the damning of your mentor Vashishta, you inane human, again fall down on earth, but with your head inversed.

glosses.meaning: heaven, [you have not yet made, [your] haunt
avaa~N shiraaH = with down turned, head [head inversed]

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तो महेन्द्रेण त्रिशंकुरपतत् पुनः
विक्रोशमानस्त्राहीति विश्वामित्रं तपोधनम् |
verses.iast:
evam ukto mahendreṇa triśaṅkuḥ apatat punaḥ
vikrośamānaḥ trāhi iti viśvāmitram tapo dhanam |
verses.translation: "When Mahendra said so, Trishanku loudly exclaiming at the ascetically wealthy Vishvamitra saying, 'save me, save me,' and fell down from heaven.

glosses.meaning: again, came back - fell down from sky.

verses.devanagari:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य क्रोशमानस्य कौशिकः
रोषमाहारयत्तीव्रं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā vacanam tasya krośamānasya kauśikaḥ
roṣam āhārayat tīvram tiṣṭha tiṣṭha iti ca abravīt |
verses.translation: "On hearing the exclamatory sentence of Trishanku who is shouting it loudly, Vishvamitra assumed an abnormal anger and also said, 'wait... wait...'

verses.devanagari:
ऋषिमध्ये स तेजस्वी प्रजापतिरिवापरः
सृजन् दक्षिणमार्गस्थान् सप्तर्षीनपरान् पुनः |
नक्षत्रमालामपरामसृजत् क्रोधमूर्च्छितः
दक्षिणां दिशमास्थाय मुनिमध्ये महायशाः |
verses.iast:
ṛṣi madhye sa tejasvī prajāpatiḥ iva aparaḥ
sṛjan dakṣiṇa mārgasthān sapta ṛṣīn aparān punaḥ |
nakṣatra vaṃśa paramparam asṛjat krodha mūrchitaḥ
dakṣiṇām diśam āsthāya muni madhye mahāyaśāḥ |
verses.translation: "Like the other Creator that resplendent Vishvamitra, himself staying among sages, has replicated Southerly Ursa Major in southerly direction. And still remaining amidst of sages that highly reputed sage Vishvamitra further started to replicate the stereotyped stocks of stars sequentially, resorting to the southern hemisphere, as he is convulsed in anger at Indra.
notes: Ursa Major is a prominent constellation in the northern sky, containing seven bright stars in a pattern variously called the Plough, the Big Dipper, or Charles's Wain. Also called Great Bear. In Latin it is, Ursa= greater (she-) bear. The Indian name to this is: sapta ṛśi maṇḍala Hence Vishvamitra adopted the opposite direction, namely southern direction, for his Creation, which shall be in direct opposition to the natural creation adopted by Almighty. From this point onwards, anything artificially or synthetically created, cloned, or replicated from natural item acquired the name of viśvāmitra ṣṛṣṭi 'Vishvamitra's cloning,' including the present day hybrids. Whether this Ursa Major like constellation is still available in southern hemisphere - is a point left to astronomers, or stargazers.

glosses.meaning: which is available - in southerly, direction
Seven, Sages [Great Bear, Southerly Ursa Major]
who in anger, convulsed - angrily - Vishvamitra

verses.devanagari:
सृष्ट्वा नक्षत्रवंशं च क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः
अन्यमिन्द्रं करिष्यामि लोको वा स्यादनिंद्रकः |
दैवतान्यपि स क्रोधात् स्रष्टुं समुपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
sṛṣṭvā nakṣatra vaṃśam ca krodhena kaluṣī kṛtaḥ
anyam indram kariṣyāmi loko vā syāt anindrakaḥ |
daivatāni api sa krodhāt sraṣṭum samupacakrame
verses.translation: "On replicating the stereotyped stocks of other galaxies and stars, and while fury continued to blemish him Vishvamitra said, 'I will now clone an alternative Indra, or let that realm created by me remain without any Indra,' and when he is about to proceed to clone even gods in his wrath, the gods are startled.

glosses.meaning: stars, families [stereotyped stocks of other galaxies,] also
fury, blemish, made by [umbrage continued to blemish him]
alternative, Indra, I will make [clone, so he surmised]
very, nearly, proceeded [about to proceed to clone - gods startled.]

verses.devanagari:
ततः परमसंभ्रान्ताः सर्षिसंघाः सुरासुराः |
विश्वामित्रं महात्मानमूचुः सानुनयं वचः
verses.iast:
tataḥ parama sambhrāntāḥ sa ṛṣi saṅghāḥ sura asurāḥ |
viśvāmitram mahātmānam ūcuḥ sa anunayam vacaḥ
verses.translation: "The gods are highly startled at Vishvamitra's creation, and they along with demons and with observances of hermits addressed the great-souled Vishvamitra with placatory words.

verses.devanagari:
अयं राजा महाभाग गुरुशापपरिक्षतः |
सशरीरो दिवं यातुं नार्हत्येव तपोधन
verses.iast:
ayam rājā mahābhāga guru śāpa parikṣataḥ |
sa śarīro divam yātum na ar.hhati eva tapo dhana
verses.translation: " 'Oh great-fortunate Vishvamitra, this king Trishnaku is damned by his mentor, hence oh, ascetically wealthy sage, he is not at all eligible to go to heaven with his mortal body.' So said gods to Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: with, mortal body, to heaven, to go

verses.devanagari:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवानां मुनिपुंगवः |
अब्रवीत् सुमहद्वाक्यं कौशिकः सर्वदेवताः
verses.iast:
teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā devānām muni puṅgavaḥ |
abravīt su mahat vākyam kauśikaḥ sarva devatāḥ
verses.translation: "On hearing that sentence of those gods, the eminent saint Kaushika spoke this highly laudable sentence to all of the gods.

verses.devanagari:
सशरीरस्य भद्रं वस्त्रिशंकोरस्य भूपतेः |
आरोहणं प्रतिज्ञातं नानृतं कर्तुमुत्सहे
verses.iast:
sa śarīrasya bhadram vaḥ trihankoḥ asya bhūpateḥ |
ārohaṇam pratijñātam na anṛtam kartum utsahe
verses.translation: " 'Let safety betide you all. I have promised to this king Trishanku that he will ascend to heaven with his mortal body, and I am not interested to make it untrue.

glosses.meaning: to you all, let safety be there
to him, for Trishanku, the king

verses.devanagari:
स्वर्गोऽस्तु सशरीरस्य त्रिशंकोरस्य शाश्वतः |
नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि मामकानि ध्रुवाण्यथ
यावल्लोका धरिष्यन्ति तिष्ठन्त्येतानि सर्वशः |
यत्कृतानि सुराः सर्वे तदनुज्ञातुमर्हथ
verses.iast:
svargo astu sa śarīrasya triśaṅkoḥ asya śāśvataḥ |
nakṣatrāṇi ca sar.hvāṇi māmakāni dhruvāṇi atha
yāvat lokā dhariṣyanti tiṣṭhanti etāni sarvaśaḥ |
yat kṛtāni surāḥ sarve tat anujñātum arhatha
verses.translation: " 'Let there be eternal heaven to Trishanku with his mortal body. Next, as along as the worlds remain, let all of these stars and galaxies I have created also remain eternally in their places as my creation. It will be apt of you all gods to accede to this.' So said Vishvamitra to gods.

glosses.meaning: eternally, heaven, let it be - let him be in heaven
as my [creation,] everywhere - in their places - they shall be there as long as
gods, all, that, to accede, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्ताः सुराः सर्वे प्रत्यूचुर्मुनिपुंगवम् |
एवं भवतु भद्रं ते तिष्ठन्त्वेतानि सर्वशः
गगने तान्यनेकानि वैश्वानरपथाद्बहिः |
नक्षत्राणि मुनिश्रेष्ठ तेषु ज्योतिषु जाज्वलन्
अवाग् शिरास्त्रिशंकुश्च तिष्ठत्वमरसंनिभः |
verses.iast:
evam uktāḥ surāḥ sarve prati ūcuḥ muni puṅgavam |
evam bhavatu bhadram te tiṣṭhantu etāni sarvaśaḥ
gagane tāni anekāni vaiśvānara pathāt bahiḥ |
nakṣatrāṇi muni śreṣṭha teṣu jyotiḥṣu jājvalan
avāg śirāḥ triśaṅkuḥ ca tiṣṭhatu amara saṃnibhaḥ |
verses.translation: "When all the gods are addressed thus they replied the eminent saint Vishvamitra saying, 'so be it! Safe you be! Let all the created objects prevail in their respective places. Those amazing and numerous stars you have created will remain in firmament, but outside the path of stelliform of Cosmic Person. Trishanku will also remain in the circle of stars you created, but upside-down, for Indra's indict cannot be annulled, and he will be gleaming like a star and similar to any celestial.

glosses.meaning: to you, let safeness be there
Cosmic Person's, stelliform, than the path of
in firmament, everywhere - in their respective places, let them prevail
in them, circle of stars - circular galaxies you created
downward, with head - in inverted position

verses.devanagari:
अनुयास्यन्ति चैतानि ज्यतींषि नृपसत्तमम्
कृतार्थं कीर्तिमन्तं च स्वर्गलोकगतं यथा |
verses.iast:
anuyāsyanti ca etāni jyotīn.hṣi nṛpa sattamam
kṛtārtham kīrtimantam ca svarga loka gatam yathā |
verses.translation: " 'According to their wont to circumambulate someone who has gone to heavenly worlds, all the stars will suppliantly circumambulate this best king Trishanku, who has achieved his ends and who has become an acclaimed one with your tour de force.' So said gods to Vishvamitra in deterring his further cloning of a simulative Universe.

glosses.meaning: acclaimed one, also - with your tour de force
to heavenly, worlds, gone, as with - someone
they will follow him - circumambulate Trishanku.

verses.devanagari:
विश्वामित्रस्तु धर्मात्मा सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुतः
ऋषिमध्ये महातेजा बाढमित्याह देवताः |
verses.iast:
viśvāmitraḥ tu dharmātmā sarva devaiḥ abhiṣṭutaḥ
ṛṣi madhye mahātejā bāḍham iti āha devatāḥ |
verses.translation: "Even the benign-souled Vishvamitra, when reverenced by all gods, that great-resplendent sage without stirring himself from among the sages said to all gods, 'Agreed!'

verses.devanagari:
ततो देवा महात्मानो ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः |
जग्मुर्यथागतं सर्वे यज्ञस्यान्ते नरोत्तम
verses.iast:
tato devā mahātmāno ṛṣayaḥ ca tapo dhanāḥ |
jagmuḥ yathā āgatam sarve yajñasya ante narottama
verses.translation: "Oh, best one among men Rama, later at the end of that ritual great-souled gods and ascetically wealthy sages went away as they have come. Thus Sage Shataananda continued the narration of the legend.

glosses.meaning: all, as, they have come, went away.
